texts: The messenger followed a narrow footpath through the forest before sunrise and counted every turning along the river until he reached an old stone bridge.
At the edge of the village an abandoned observatory stood above the hills its brass instruments covered with dust and its windows facing the distant sea.
Beneath the courtyard a forgotten staircase descended toward a passage where faint marks on the stones suggested that someone had recently passed through.
After midnight the surveyor examined his map and measured the shadows cast by the lantern beside the northern entrance before recording the final distance.
